# Webrick

> Webrick is a web and software development studio based in India. It builds custom websites, e-commerce stores, web applications, mobile apps and business software for startups, local businesses and growing companies.

## Services

- Website Development: modern, responsive and high-performing websites for businesses.
- Web Applications: custom web applications designed around business requirements.
- E-Commerce: scalable online stores on Shopify, WooCommerce and custom stacks.
- UI/UX Development: clean, intuitive and conversion-focused digital interfaces.
- Mobile Applications: mobile apps for Android and iOS, built with Flutter and React Native.
- Business Solutions: custom digital tools and software, including CRMs and internal tools.

## Products

- SabseraCRM: a calling CRM for sales teams. Leads, click-to-call, call logs, recordings and follow-up reminders in one screen, with a live dashboard per agent.

## How Webrick works

- Discover, Design, Develop, Test, Launch.
- Fixed scope, weekly updates and one point of contact from kickoff to launch.
- Every project is custom-built, mobile-first and tested for performance.

## Technology

React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, PHP, Laravel, Python, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Shopify, WordPress, WooCommerce, Flutter, React Native, AWS, Docker, Vercel.

## Pricing

Projects start from INR 5,000. A fixed quote is given before work begins.
